id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Switched Ethernet line / star / tree / ring (MRP). PROFINET devices typically integrate a 2-port switch for daisy-chaining; a ring with a Media Redundancy Manager gives redundancy. IRT requires a fixed, planned topology (LLDP + offline schedule).

supported_topologies.name: Ring (MRP)
supported_topologies.description: Media Redundancy Manager blocks one port; <= 200 ms recovery.

supported_topologies.name: Planned IRT topology
supported_topologies.description: Fixed, LLDP-known topology with an offline-computed red/green schedule (CC-C).

master_slave_role_summary.description: PLC; establishes ARs, provides outputs, consumes inputs, handles alarms.
Field device; provides inputs, consumes outputs; slot/subslot model.
PTCP roles in the sync domain (IRT).

fields.interconnect_role: PROFINET is a switched-Ethernet field network. The IO-Controller is the central master of each AR; IO-Devices are the field nodes. Cyclic data is provider/consumer, prioritized at Layer-2 (RT) or hardware-scheduled (IRT). Redundancy (MRP) and time sync (PTCP) are network-wide services.

ordering_guarantees.cyclic_liveness: APDU Cycle Counter detects missed/late/duplicated frames.
ordering_guarantees.irt_determinism: planned schedule gives bounded latency / jitter < 1 us.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: PROFINET's addressable state is the slot/subslot I/O image and the record/index model (API, Slot, Subslot, Index), not a flat memory map; control-plane identity is DCP-managed.

device_classification.DTE: Data Terminal Equipment — endpoint host (PC, server, IP camera, IoT device).
device_classification.DCE: Data Circuit-terminating Equipment — switch port, router port, repeater port.
device_classification.PHY: Single-port PHY transceiver; one MII / GMII / RGMII data path + one MDI port + management bus interface.
device_classification.Multi-port_PHY: N MII / GMII ports on one chip with internal switch fabric.
device_classification.Switch_ASIC: Many ports + forwarding engine; one MAC + PHY pair per port; STA bus drives all PHYs.
device_classification.NIC: Network Interface Controller — MAC + PHY + DMA engine + host bus interface (PCIe).
device_classification.io_controller: PLC controlling field devices over ARs.
device_classification.io_device: Distributed field I/O / drive / sensor station.
